recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. The current FHIR-core source satisfies FHIR-13376 after considering both the original GFM migration and the later FHIR-38714 clarification; no follow-up source edit is needed for this seed.
issue_request: FHIR-13376 asked FHIR-I to choose a single markdown specification across the FHIR ecosystem. The Jira comments considered CommonMark, GFM, tables, and HTML/security handling; the issue was Published/Persuasive for STU3 with a 6-0-0 vote.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit c1140fdc201c3aa2e13060bc4bd1e573a0a3d80e, 'GF#13376 - migrate to GFM for markdown', which changed source/datatypes.html from older variable/preferred markdown language to GFM extensions on CommonMark and removed the STU note requesting future CommonMark feedback.
additional_context: Later Published issue FHIR-38714 refined the security-sensitive part of the markdown datatype, clarifying that FHIR markdown uses GFM/CommonMark with inline HTML unsupported and processors treating embedded XML tags as string content. FHIR-38714 is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/datatypes.html already defines markdown as the GFM extension of CommonMark and includes the no-inline-HTML processor guidance; source/datatypes/primitives.xml also identifies markdown as Github Flavored Markdown, and fhir.ini shows these datatype sources are active build inputs.

related_jiras.note: Clarified no-inline-HTML and embedded XML tag handling for FHIR markdown; already reconciled on the combined branch and used only as context for this seed.
